question: Where is the nearest emergency hospital located relative to Ritter Park Rose Garden, Huntington, WV?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Ritter Park Rose Garden%' LIMIT 1 )::geography) AS distance_meters FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'hospital' AND p.emergency = 'yes' AND p.addr_city ILIKE '%Huntington%' AND p.addr_state ILIKE '%WV%' ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Ritter Park Rose Garden%' LIMIT 1 )::geography) LIMIT 1;
